release_note:
- Important security update: version 1.43.3 addresses multiple security
  issues. Plex recommends all server owners using 1.43.2 or earlier
  update as soon as possible. CVE identifiers have been requested but
  are not yet published.
- Security fixes address a potential CompanionProxy vulnerability
  (PM-5763) and prevent TranscoderH264Options and
  TranscoderH264OptionsOverride from being modified over the network
  (PM-5766).
- Also adds audio-codec filters, IPv6-only network support,
  DVB teletext subtitles, AV1 transcoder-setting support, and Plex Web
  4.160.0, with additional library, metadata, transcoding, crash,
  and DASH fixes.
